# Carousel block

## Fields {#fields}

Field

Type

Description

Required?

`type`

String

The type of block. For a carousel block, `type` is always `carousel`.

Required

`elements`

Array

A list of cards. The carousel must contain at least one card, with a maximum of 10 cards.

Required

`block_id`

String

A unique identifier for a block. If not specified, a `block_id` will be generated.

Optional
